name: Four Seasons Hotel Tunis
insider_take: This Mediterranean jewel seamlessly blends French colonial elegance with North African mystique, offering an oasis of luxury just steps from the ancient medina.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a prime position in the prestigious Gammarth district, where Roman ruins meet pristine beaches. Its stunning architecture incorporates traditional Tunisian tile work and mashrabiya screens, while the spa features authentic hammam treatments using local olive oil and sea salt from nearby Chott el-Jerid.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner on the terrace during winter months - you'll enjoy perfect weather while savoring views of the Gulf of Tunis and the distant Atlas Mountains, plus it's jasmine blooming season.
dont_miss: The UNESCO World Heritage medina is a 15-minute drive away, home to the stunning Zitouna Mosque and vibrant souks selling handwoven Berber carpets. The nearby Carthage archaeological site reveals fascinating Punic and Roman history, including Hannibal's legendary departure point for his march on Rome.
pros: Iconic Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Prime location in Tunisia's capital city
Gateway to North African culture and Mediterranean coastline
cons: Urban setting may lack resort atmosphere
